newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong Motor in Egypt car export deal.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong Motor in Egypt car export deal.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Motor Co, a unit of Ssangyong Group, said on Tuesday it has reached an agreement with Egypt's Engineering Automotive Manufacturing Co to supply complete knockdown kit vehicles.

Ssangyong said in a statement it would deliver kit parts for 1,000 four-wheel drive "Mussos" in 1997. The number is expected to rise to 1,500 units in 1998 and more than 2,000 units annually from the year 2000, it said.
Engineering Automotive Manufacturing will assemble and sell the cars in Egypt, it said. It did not give a value for the deal.
